problems.title: Reversed extremum direction in purported verification example
problems.claim: Displayed box is the minimizer and other eligible boxes yield larger squared radii.
problems.evidence: Explicit eligible repeated-side alternative has squared radius below657/64; correct sphere problem takes maximum.
problems.counterevidence: Final answer721 is correct; trace can legitimately contain errors, but verification annotation overstates its validity.

independent_verification.source_claim: Read original physical pp8,12,13,18, including actual Figure9 image. The transcript and highlighted summary repeatedly say minimize and end with a claim that other eligible dimensions have larger r^2; p8 and caption interpret this as successful verification.
independent_verification.assumptions_verified: All box sides positive, surface2(ab+bc+ca)=54, volumeabc=23. Each box circumradius is half its diagonal; the sphere covering every box therefore takes the maximum, regardless of individual orientation.

decisive_check.method: New Decimal evaluation at60 digits and analytic stationary-point argument
decisive_check.global_repair: Feasible sides obey a>=23/27 and a<=729/92 (and cyclic versions), hence compactness. Constraint gradients are independent unless a=b=c, which cannot satisfy both constraints. Pairwise Lagrange differences force two sides equal. Positive repeated-side solutions are2 and2sqrt6-1; the third root is negative. Comparing the two yields maximum657/64.

independent_verification.counterevidence: The example is an authentic generated trace and its final answer remains correct. A wrong trace alone does not refute a final-answer benchmark, but the accompanying successful-verification claim overstates its reasoning.
independent_verification.core_dependency: One illustrative explanation of reflection; no demonstrated dependence of aggregate gains on this trace.
independent_verification.severity_and_repair: Minor retained. Correct the explanatory annotation/maximum proof without silently replacing historical model output.

problems.title: Greedy protocol does not specify the source of variation in repeated AIME averages
problems.claim: 30questions evaluated32times with greedy decoding; ownT1 score50.6%.
problems.evidence: Deterministic fixed greedy result lies on100k/30 grid;50.6%cannot round from that grid.
problems.counterevidence: Hardware nondeterminism or unstated stochastic/prompt settings could explain variation; score not declared false.
problems.dependency: Reproducibility and uncertainty of headline AIME evaluation.
problems.repair: Provide decoding/run settings and per-question outputs; historical metric impact Needs Evidence.

independent_verification.source_claim: Read p13 Evaluation paragraph (30questions,32runs,greedy sampling with SGLANG) and p4 Table1 own T1-32B AIME50.6%.
independent_verification.assumptions_verified: The grid argument is conditional on fixed model, prompts, benchmark and fully deterministic greedy computation. Greedy token selection alone does not ensure numerical determinism across batching/hardware.
independent_verification.decisive_check: For deterministic identical repeats,32 repetitions cancel from the average, leaving100k/30. Nearest values are50.0 and53.3333, neither rounds to50.6. Under variable runs,486/960=50.625% does round to50.6, so the number is arithmetically feasible.
independent_verification.counterevidence: Nondeterminism, varying prompts or missing decoding details can account for variation. No internal score falsity or misconduct inference is supported. Borrowed scores are not used as evidence against the own-model protocol.
independent_verification.core_dependency: The source of variation and uncertainty for the repeated headline evaluation is under-specified, while actual performance remains unresolved.
independent_verification.severity_and_repair: Minor reporting/reproducibility gap retained; historical metric impact Needs Evidence. Need per-question responses and full run/decoding settings; repeated fixed outputs are not independent samples.

repair_verification: Explicit box counterexample and repaired maximum comparison checked; evaluation protocol cannot be reconstructed without missing outputs.
